claim_text: Some adults aged 50 years and older may have reduced absorption of naturally food-bound vitamin B12; fortified foods and supplements provide forms that do not require release from food proteins in the same way.
health_goal_or_outcome: Support safe assessment of nutrient intake and avoid inappropriate or duplicate supplementation.

population.other_context: Adults aged 50 years and older; assess fortified-food and supplement intake.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Food, fortified foods and/or relevant supplement preparations; verify exact product form and label.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS B12 Health Professional Fact Sheet describes food-bound B12 absorption and fortified/supplemental sources.
limitations: Age alone does not diagnose deficiency; symptoms and laboratory findings require clinical evaluation.
Source claim and cited underlying studies require full-text appraisal before approval.
